skill.description: Manage Home Assistant configuration, automations, remote validation, deployment workflows, and Lovelace dashboards with guided SSH, hass-cli, git, and scp patterns.
skill.summary: Guide safe Home Assistant configuration, automation, and dashboard workflows.
skill.author: komal-SkyNET

security_audit.summary: The package is a Markdown skill with a supporting dashboard image and no prompt injection text found in the reviewed files. Many static matches are Markdown formatting or documentation placeholders, but the skill intentionally guides agents through SSH, scp, git, hass-cli, and Home Assistant restart workflows. This should require explicit command review, scoped credentials, and careful handling of Home Assistant storage files.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any SSH, scp, git, hass-cli, reload, or restart command is executed.
Prefer least-privilege Home Assistant access where possible and clearly warn users before commands target root@homeassistant.local.
Add backup, syntax validation, and rollback steps before copying files into Home Assistant .storage paths.
Recommend a secret manager or protected environment file, and avoid placing tokens in shell history or command-line headers.
Pin installation instructions to a release tag or commit and document checksum verification for downloaded archives.

content.value_statement: Home Assistant changes can be slow and risky without validation and clear deployment steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through checks, reload choices, dashboard workflows, and verification.
actual_capabilities: Plan Home Assistant deployment workflows using git, scp, SSH, and hass-cli patterns.
Guide configuration validation before reloads, restarts, or dashboard deployment.
Support automation testing with manual triggers, log checks, and outcome verification.
Design Lovelace dashboards for tablets, wall panels, and touch-friendly controls.
Troubleshoot Jinja2 templates, dashboard registration, card syntax, and entity state issues.
Choose reload or restart paths based on the type of Home Assistant change.
limitations: Requires user-provided Home Assistant access, SSH configuration, and valid hass-cli credentials.
Does not include executable scripts or direct API integrations by itself.
Command examples can affect live smart home devices if run without review.
Home Assistant, custom cards, and MCP documentation may change after the skill was written.

use_cases.title: Deploy Configuration Changes

use_cases.description: Design Lovelace layouts with touch-friendly cards, responsive grids, and clear status indicators.

prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Home Assistant project setup and tell me what access, tools, and credentials are needed before using this skill.

prompt_templates.title: Verify an Automation Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me update an automation, choose the safest reload path, trigger it for testing, and review the expected log checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Tablet Dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lovelace dashboard plan for an 11-inch tablet with lights, doors, climate, and security status.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a safe Home Assistant configuration migration with validation, rollback steps, reload decisions, and post-deployment verification.

output_examples.input: Create an automation for a door left open longer than five minutes.
output: A proposed automation workflow with validation steps.
A reload and manual trigger plan for testing.
A log review checklist and commit recommendation.

output_examples.input: Build a wall tablet dashboard for lights, doors, blinds, climate, and vacuum status.
output: A dashboard structure organized for touch use.
Recommended card types for each control group.
Deployment, refresh, and visual testing steps.

output_examples.input: My dashboard card has a template type error.
output: A diagnosis path for the template error.
Guidance to test the template in Developer Tools.

best_practices: Review every SSH, scp, git, and hass-cli command before execution.
Validate configuration and dashboard syntax before restarting Home Assistant.
Use temporary deployment for testing, then commit only stable changes.
anti_patterns: Do not run restart or service commands without confirming the target instance.
Do not store long-lived tokens in shared shell profiles or command history.
Do not edit Home Assistant .storage files without a backup and validation step.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to Home Assistant by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and command patterns. The user must configure access and approve any tool execution.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It references SSH, git, scp, hass-cli, and optional Context7 MCP documentation access.

faq.question: Can it restart Home Assistant?
faq.answer: The skill includes restart workflows. Users should review the exact command and confirm the target before execution.

faq.question: Is it useful for dashboards?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Lovelace dashboard registration, card selection, tablet layout, and template troubleshooting guidance.

faq.question: Does it include secret credentials?
faq.answer: No embedded credentials were found. The README uses placeholders for user-provided tokens and API keys.

faq.question: Should commands be run automatically?
faq.answer: No. Commands can modify live smart home systems, so they should require explicit user review.
